title: papyrus-infra silently defaults CDK account to legacy 335163751677; resolve via STS
description: bin/papyrus-infra.mjs falls back to legacy account 335163751677 when --account and CDK_DEFAULT_ACCOUNT are unset (Amplify builds), so deploy fails assuming the legacy CDK deploy role (Pilobolus builds 37/38). Fix: resolve account via aws sts get-caller-identity, region from AWS_REGION/AWS_DEFAULT_REGION/CDK_DEFAULT_REGION default us-east-1, clear error otherwise.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Fixed upstream: papyrus-infra resolves the CDK account via STS, no legacy default (Papyrus #363, f7c383c8). Recovered from an uncommitted local board during the 2026-10-20 reconcile.
